name: Chicken, Peach & Spinach Salad with Feta & Balsamic Vinaigrette

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 peaches
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the spinach to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pit; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown on the outside and cooked through in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Cook in batches if necessary.
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add feta to the salad bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad between plates and top with the chicken strips. Enjoy!
